basic_profile.bio: I'm a 29-year-old tech enthusiast and a recent fan of the Las Vegas Raiders. Originally from Ohio, I've recently moved to Nevada for a new job opportunity in IT support. I'm still finding my way around the Reddit platform and exploring different communities. My interests include blockchain technology, modding video games, and the music scene. I usually browse Reddit during my lunch breaks and late evenings. Currently single, I'm enjoying meeting new people both online and offline.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My background is primarily in information technology, having studied computer science at a state university. Over the years, I've taught myself about blockchain and cryptocurrency, which led me to frequently visit the SecretNetwork subreddit. I'm also keen on gaming and modding, which is why I spend time on subreddits like SkyFactory and Ash.
